title: Jesus… Should I Tell Everyone When I'm Angry?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus… when I'm angry, can I just tell everyone how I feel?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't have to tell the whole world what is happening inside you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But if I keep it inside, won't I feel worse?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Bring your anger to Me before you spread it to everyone else.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So I shouldn't post about the people who hurt me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: A wise heart knows when to speak… and when to be still.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What do you do when you're angry?

bible.text: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
